subject: Architecture
title: Neuschwanstein: The Fairy Tale Castle
description: Learn Neuschwanstein: The Fairy Tale Castle in one minute.

hook.text: King Ludwig II of Bavaria built a fantasy castle based on Wagner opera stage sets.

buildup.text: Neuschwanstein perches on a cliff with turrets, towers, and murals of medieval legends.

discovery.text: It looks medieval but was built in 1869 with steel beams, central heating, and flush toilets.

twist.text: Ludwig was declared insane before the castle was finished. He died three days later mysteriously.

climax.text: Walt Disney visited and modeled Sleeping Beauty's Castle directly on Neuschwanstein.

punchline.text: A mad king's fantasy became every child's idea of a castle.

quiz.question: What inspired Walt Disney's Sleeping Beauty Castle design?
